## Table 4. MTP-II standardised effects (β, p), length and frequency controlled

| Emotion ~ predictor | HUTB β | HUTB p | DISCO β | DISCO p | Same direction and both significant? |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Dominance ~ dependency length | -0.090 | < .001 | -0.087 | < .001 | yes |

| Dominance ~ LSTM surprisal | -0.023 | .412 | -0.028 | .161 | no |

| Valence ~ trigram surprisal | +0.035 | .403 | -0.146 | < .001 | no |
| Dominance ~ trigram surprisal | -0.195 | < .001 | +0.129 | < .001 | no |
| Arousal ~ trigram surprisal | -0.150 | < .001 | +0.177 | < .001 | no |

One surprisal measure per model, plus dependency length and controls (HUTB: log length, EMILLE log frequency; DISCO: log length, mean Zipf frequency, task domain). OLS on z-scored variables, HC3 SE. The dependency-length row is from the LSTM model; in the trigram model it is -0.070 (HUTB) and -0.086 (DISCO).
